ruleLine: a compartment pays only on a trump (the Pope, 9 of diamonds, is the exception) / the 8 of diamonds is out, so a run always dies at the 7
board: Board (unclaimed compartments carry over to the next deal)
selectLead: The run is stopped -- lead your LOWEST card, any suit
selectFollow: Pick the next higher card of the same suit
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.lead: the run is stopped, so lead your lowest card
hint.follow: the next higher card of the same suit
tutorial.trumpOnly: A compartment pays only on a trump. Matching the rank is not enough -- an off-suit king pays nothing. The Pope (nine of diamonds) is the one exception.
tutorial.carryOver: Chips on a compartment nobody claims stay put and carry into the next deal. The dealer dresses the board again, so Pope and Matrimony build up.
tutorial.eightOut: The eight of diamonds is out of the pack, so nothing can follow the seven -- a run always dies there. A king stops a run too, since nothing outranks it.
tutorial.popeExcused: When someone goes out, everyone pays one chip per card still held -- except whoever is holding the Pope, who is excused.
